chapterInfo.content:
16
Yesu wusɔreɛ no
(Mateo 28.1-8; Luka 24.1-12; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Na homeda no twaa mu no, Maria Magdalene, Yakobo ne na Maria ne Salome tɔɔ nnuhwam sɛ wɔde reba abɛsra no. 2Na da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan anɔpahema, wɔbaa ɛda no so, na owia apue. 3Na wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛmuni ɔboɔ no afiri ɛda no ano ama yɛn? 4Na wɔmaa wɔn ani so no, wɔhunuu sɛ ɔboɔ no amuni; nso na ɛso kokuroo. 5Na wɔkɔɔ ɛda no mu no, wɔhunuu aberanteɛ bi sɛ ɔte nifa soɔ, hyɛ atadeɛ tentene fitaa, na wɔbɔɔ binim. 6Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mommmɔ binim; mohwehwɛ Yesu Nasareni a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no. Wanyane, ɔnni ha. Hwɛ faako a wɔde no toeɛ! 7#Mar 14.28 Na monkɔ nkɔka nkyerɛ n’asuafoɔ ne Petro sɛ ɔredi mo anim akɔ Galilea; ɛhɔ na mobɛhu no, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no. 8Na wɔfirii adi ntɛm ara dwane firii ɛda no ho; na ahopopoɔ ne ahodwirie aka wɔn. Na wɔanka hwee ankyerɛ obiara; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro.
Maria Magdalene hunu Yesu
9 # Luka 8.2; Yoh 20.11-18 [Na ɔsɔree da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan anɔpatutu no, ɔyii ne ho adi kane kyerɛɛ Maria Magdalene a ɔtuu ahonhommɔne nson firii ne mu no. 10Na ɔkɔ kɔsee wɔn a wɔne no tenaeɛ a na wɔn werɛ ahoɔ na wɔresu no. 11Na wɔn deɛ wɔtee sɛ ɔte aseɛ na wɔahu no no, wɔannye anni.
Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ Asuafoɔ baanu
12 # Luka 24.13-35 Yeinom akyiri no, ɔyii ne ho adi suban foforɔ mu kyerɛɛ wɔn mu baanu a na wɔnam rekɔ akuraa. 13Na wɔn nso ba bɛka kyerɛɛ nkaeɛ no; na wɔannye wɔn nso anni.
(Luka 24.36-49; Yohane 20.19-23)
14 # 1 Ko 15.5 Akyire yi a dubaako no te adidiiɛ no, ɔyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn, na ɔkaa wɔn anim gye a wɔnnye nni no ne wɔn akomaden ho, sɛ wɔannye wɔn a wɔhunuu no sɛ wasɔre no annie nti.
Asomafoɔ no asɛmpa ka
15 # Mat 28.18-20 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ wiase nyinaa nkɔka asɛmpa no nkyerɛ abɔdeɛ nyinaa. 16#Aso 2.38 Deɛ ɔgye die, na wɔbɔ no asu no wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na deɛ ɔnnye nnie no, wɔbɛbu no fɔ. 17#Aso 16.18; 2.4, 11; 10.46 Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yi bɛdi wɔn a wɔbɛgye adie akyi: Me din mu, wɔbɛtu ahonhommɔne, wɔbɛkasa kasa foforɔ, 18#Luka 10.19; Aso 28.3-6; Yak 5.14-15 wɔbɛma awɔ so, na sɛ wɔnom adubɔne biara a, ɛrenyɛ wɔn hwee; wɔde nsa bɛgu ayarefoɔ so ama wɔn ho ayɛ wɔn den.
Yesu sorokorɔ
(Luka 24.50-53; Asomafoɔ 1.4-11)
19 # Dwom 110.1; Aso 7.55 Na afei, Awurade Yesu ne wɔn kasaeɛ akyiri no, wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro, na ɔkɔtenaa Nyankopɔn nifa. 20#Heb 2.4 Na wɔn deɛ, wɔfirii hɔ kɔ kɔkaa asɛm mmaa nyinaa, na Awurade ne wɔn yɛɛ adwuma, nam nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛka ho no so hyɛɛ asɛm no den.]#16.20 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye to mu binom mfa nkyekyɛmu 9 kɔsi 20 no nka ho. Amen.#16.20 Tete atwerɛ a wɔagye atom afoforɔ no bi de Amen aka ho.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na homeda no twaa mu no, Maria Magdalene, Yakobo ne na Maria ne Salome tɔɔ nnuhwam sɛ wɔde reba abɛsra no. Na da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan anɔpahema, wɔbaa ɛda no so, na owia apue. Na wɔsesee wɔn ho sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛmuni ɔboɔ no afiri ɛda no ano ama yɛn? Na wɔmaa wɔn ani so no, wɔhunuu sɛ ɔboɔ no amuni; nso na ɛso kokuroo. Na wɔkɔɔ ɛda no mu no, wɔhunuu aberanteɛ bi sɛ ɔte nifa soɔ, hyɛ atadeɛ tentene fitaa, na wɔbɔɔ binim. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mommmɔ binim; mohwehwɛ Yesu Nasareni a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no. Wanyane, ɔnni ha. Hwɛ faako a wɔde no toeɛ! Na monkɔ nkɔka nkyerɛ n’asuafoɔ ne Petro sɛ ɔredi mo anim akɔ Galilea; ɛhɔ na mobɛhu no, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no. Na wɔfirii adi ntɛm ara dwane firii ɛda no ho; na ahopopoɔ ne ahodwirie aka wɔn. Na wɔanka hwee ankyerɛ obiara; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro.

[Na ɔsɔree da a ɛdi nnawɔtwe kan anɔpatutu no, ɔyii ne ho adi kane kyerɛɛ Maria Magdalene a ɔtuu ahonhommɔne nson firii ne mu no. Na ɔkɔ kɔsee wɔn a wɔne no tenaeɛ a na wɔn werɛ ahoɔ na wɔresu no. Na wɔn deɛ wɔtee sɛ ɔte aseɛ na wɔahu no no, wɔannye anni.

Yeinom akyiri no, ɔyii ne ho adi suban foforɔ mu kyerɛɛ wɔn mu baanu a na wɔnam rekɔ akuraa. Na wɔn nso ba bɛka kyerɛɛ nkaeɛ no; na wɔannye wɔn nso anni.

Akyire yi a dubaako no te adidiiɛ no, ɔyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn, na ɔkaa wɔn anim gye a wɔnnye nni no ne wɔn akomaden ho, sɛ wɔannye wɔn a wɔhunuu no sɛ wasɔre no annie nti.

Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ wiase nyinaa nkɔka asɛmpa no nkyerɛ abɔdeɛ nyinaa. Deɛ ɔgye die, na wɔbɔ no asu no wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na deɛ ɔnnye nnie no, wɔbɛbu no fɔ. Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yi bɛdi wɔn a wɔbɛgye adie akyi: Me din mu, wɔbɛtu ahonhommɔne, wɔbɛkasa kasa foforɔ, wɔbɛma awɔ so, na sɛ wɔnom adubɔne biara a, ɛrenyɛ wɔn hwee; wɔde nsa bɛgu ayarefoɔ so ama wɔn ho ayɛ wɔn den.


Na afei, Awurade Yesu ne wɔn kasaeɛ akyiri no, wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro, na ɔkɔtenaa Nyankopɔn nifa. Na wɔn deɛ, wɔfirii hɔ kɔ kɔkaa asɛm mmaa nyinaa, na Awurade ne wɔn yɛɛ adwuma, nam nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛka ho no so hyɛɛ asɛm no den.] Amen.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
